notes: Programme is a binational double degree taught entirely at ITS Surabaya / Polimarin Semarang in Indonesia. The only stated application route is by e-mail; uni-assist is mentioned on a general application page only for "some degree programmes", so applicationChannel is recorded as de-university-direct with a weak quote. The DAAD deadline of 15 July is given without a year, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline.
